# Communication

Short call sheet. Audio on amateur tape is usually dead. Score this only when audio is usable. Otherwise `call: unknown`.

## Calls

- Keeper
- Away
- Set
- Step
- Hold

One word. Early. Before the play needs it.

## Cue

If you are coming, the call happens before the first step. Silent come is how you take out your own last man.
